metadata.title: Soulful Portraiture with Vertical Slab-Serif Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A tight, high-contrast facial portrait featuring heavy shadows and a vertical column of bold, white slab-serif text along the right margin.
triggerTerms: extreme close-up portrait with vertical text
bold white slab serif on dark background

recipe.visualDefinition: An extreme close-up of a human face, cropped tightly so the forehead and chin are near the edges. The lighting is dramatic and directional, casting one side of the face into deep shadow while highlighting skin texture, pores, and the reflective moisture of the eyes. A single vertical line of large, white, high-contrast typography runs down the right-hand side.
coreVisualRelationships: The vertical text column balances the heavy shadow on the left side of the face.
The highlight on the nose and cheek creates a central focal point between the dark left and the text-heavy right.
The scale of the face creates an intimate, confrontational relationship with the viewer.
The white text pops sharply against the dark, textured background of the subject's hair and skin.
coreInvariants: Vertical text orientation on the right margin
Visible film grain or skin texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face occupies 90% of the frame, slightly offset to the left to accommodate the text.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes, specifically the one in the light, serve as the primary emotional anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the illuminated eye, moves down the bridge of the nose to the mouth, then jumps to the vertical text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows on the left and the dark area behind the text act as functional negative space.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep umber and black (shadows and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the shadows and the white text.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Characters are rotated 90 degrees to read vertically or stacked upright in a column

anatomy.strokeCharacter: Thick vertical stems with thin horizontals

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for maximum impact; secondary metadata in small sans-serif at corners.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the high-contrast, blocky slab-serif aesthetic of the era.
Provides the necessary weight and geometric slab serifs.
A widely available alternative with similar geometric proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, high-contrast, low-key portrait of a face in extreme close-up. Use directional lighting to create deep shadows on one side and highlight skin texture on the other. Ensure the right side has a dark area suitable for text overlay.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a vertical column of text on the right side using an extra-bold slab-serif font in solid white. Stack the letters vertically from top to bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the face cropped tightly enough to show skin texture?
Is the text perfectly vertical on the right margin?
Is the contrast between the white text and dark background sharp?
Is the lighting dramatic and directional?

mustRedesign: Do not use soft, diffused lighting
Do not use modern sans-serif fonts
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text overlaps the eyes
recipe.reuseFormula: Extreme close-up portrait + Chiaroscuro lighting + Vertical slab-serif right-aligned text.
